correctness.rationale: After central normalization, the six vertices are \(v_1,v_2,v_3,-v_1,-v_2,-v_3\) and their three positive determinant gaps \(a,b,c\) sum to the area. The published support-triangle identity converts \(c^{\mathrm{tr}}\) to \(1+8\max A_K/\operatorname{area}(K)\). Exact evaluation at the three independent vertices yields \(\max A_K\ge\frac12\max\{a,b,c\}\ge\operatorname{area}(K)/6\), proving \(7/3\). Equality forces \(a=b=c\), which determinant ratios convert to the canonical affine-regular coordinates. The converse is checked directly on all edges of that canonical hexagon. No finite computation is used as a proof.
